project.name: Importer: GUDID
project.description: Imports the FDA's Global Unique Device Identification Database (AccessGUDID's delimited release, with the FDA product classification file) on the starter set. Ported from IKM's gudid-data transformation plugin onto the store writer, keeping its identities; carries IKM's GUDID starter data (its module, author, identifier sources, specialties and GMDN pattern).
